columns.title: Points percentage: points scored over points conceded

modelNotes: Team ratings come from score margins (capped at 40) with home advantage, fitted on this and last season with a 60-day half-life; last season counts 1x as much on top.
The rest of the regular season is simulated 20,000 times, letting team strength drift (more when more of the season is left), then the playoffs are simulated from each simulated table for title odds.
The table breaks ties on win percentage with the league's rules: points percentage (points scored over points conceded). Simulated seasons break ties at random.
Ignite Cup games count on the ladder; the Ignite Cup Finals do not and are left out.
